correctness.rationale: For simple cycles C_n,n>=3, fair iid conformist/rebel signs t_i and binary action signs x_i, payoff t_i x_i(x_{i-1}+x_{i+1}), edge products e_i=x_ix_{i+1} have product +1 and two action lifts. Projection onto even edge-product parity gives Z_n(t)=tr prod B_t+tr prod(B_t D). Independence gives E Z_n=tr A^n+tr(AD)^n. Two replicas with four joint edge sign states and four parity characters give E Z_n²=tr K^n+tr(KD_e)^n+tr(KD_f)^n+tr(KD_eD_f)^n. Independently expanded all four displayed characteristic polynomials exactly and exhaustively summed direct-payoff equilibrium counts for all 2^n fair-type words for n=3..8; exact means and second moments match. Dominant eigenvalues 3/2 and (5+sqrt17)/4 give normalized variance exponent (5+sqrt17)/9>1. This is an exact all-n transfer proof, not a finite experimental inference.
